description.value:
You scoff at sealing techniques. Your body is the technique. Through brutal early-morning conditioning, taijutsu-only training arcs, and the discipline of a master without chakra, you turn your fists, palms, knees, and elbows into the fastest jutsu of all.

Hit Points 10 + Constitution

Key Attribute Strength

Initial Proficiencies trained in simple and martial weapons; expert in unarmed attacks; trained in light/medium armor, expert in unarmored defense; expert Fortitude and Reflex, trained Will; trained in Athletics plus 4 additional skills

Spellcasting none. Taijutsu Specialists do not learn jutsu spell slots; you still gain Charge Chakra at 1st level but your chakra reservoir is small — you may take feats to access a small pool of jutsu (see future archetype).

TODO: when the chakra-less subclass picker is finalized, allow Taijutsu Specialists to skip Charge Chakra entirely in exchange for an additional class feat at 1st level.

At 1st level you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChakraReser0]{Chakra Reserves}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtChargeChakr0]{Charge Chakra}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtTaijutsuSpc0]{Taijutsu Specialization}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-features.Item.ClFtTaijutsuPth0]{Taijutsu Style}.
